+"""Behavioural tests for the borough lido admissions desk."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+import pytest
+
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
+
+from lido import admit, roll_call
+
+
+def session(kind="family", capacity=3, admitted=0):
+    return {"kind": kind, "capacity": capacity, "admitted": admitted}
+
+
+def swimmer(name="Ada", age=20, member=False, accompanied=True):
+    return {
+        "name": name,
+        "age": age,
+        "member": member,
+        "accompanied": accompanied,
+    }
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("a_session", "a_swimmer"),
+    [
+        (session(kind="club"), swimmer(member=False)),
+        (session(kind="lane"), swimmer(age=15)),
+        (session(), swimmer(age=7, accompanied=False)),
+    ],
+)
+def test_admit_refuses_swimmers_who_break_an_entry_rule(a_session, a_swimmer):
+    assert admit(a_session, a_swimmer) == "refused"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("kind", "age", "accompanied"),
+    [
+        ("lane", 16, True),
+        ("family", 8, False),
+        ("club", 8, False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_admit_accepts_the_age_boundaries(kind, age, accompanied):
+    assert admit(session(kind=kind), swimmer(age=age, member=True, accompanied=accompanied)) == "admitted"
+
+
+def test_admit_checks_refusal_rules_before_reporting_a_full_session():
+    full = session(kind="club", capacity=1, admitted=1)
+
+    assert admit(full, swimmer(member=False)) == "refused"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("capacity", "admitted", "member", "expected"),
+    [
+        (3, 0, True, "admitted"),
+        (3, 2, True, "admitted"),
+        (3, 3, True, "waiting"),
+        (3, 0, False, "admitted"),
+        (3, 1, False, "admitted"),
+        (3, 2, False, "waiting"),
+        (1, 0, False, "waiting"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_admit_reserves_the_last_place_for_a_member(capacity, admitted, member, expected):
+    assert admit(session(capacity=capacity, admitted=admitted), swimmer(member=member)) == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "bad_session",
+    [
+        session(kind="party"),
+        session(capacity=0),
+        session(admitted=-1),
+        session(capacity=2, admitted=3),
+    ],
+)
+def test_admit_rejects_invalid_sessions_before_deciding(bad_session):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        admit(bad_session, swimmer())
+
+
+def test_admit_rejects_a_negative_age_before_deciding():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        admit(session(), swimmer(age=-1))
+
+
+def test_roll_call_processes_the_queue_in_order_and_keeps_places_taken():
+    queue = [
+        swimmer("Nia", member=False),
+        swimmer("Mo", member=True),
+        swimmer("Ivo", member=False),
+        swimmer("Rae", member=True),
+    ]
+
+    result = roll_call(session(capacity=3), queue)
+
+    assert result == {
+        "admitted": ["Nia", "Mo", "Rae"],
+        "waiting": ["Ivo"],
+        "refused": [],
+    }
+
+
+def test_roll_call_does_not_use_a_place_for_a_refused_or_waiting_swimmer():
+    queue = [
+        swimmer("Too young", age=7, accompanied=False, member=True),
+        swimmer("Waiting", member=False),
+        swimmer("Member", member=True),
+    ]
+
+    result = roll_call(session(capacity=1), queue)
+
+    assert result == {
+        "admitted": ["Member"],
+        "waiting": ["Waiting"],
+        "refused": ["Too young"],
+    }
+
+
+def test_roll_call_leaves_the_callers_session_unchanged():
+    original = session(capacity=3, admitted=1)
+
+    roll_call(original, [swimmer("Member", member=True)])
+
+    assert original == session(capacity=3, admitted=1)
+
+
+def test_roll_call_propagates_validation_errors():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        roll_call(session(), [swimmer(age=-1)])
+
+
+def test_roll_call_of_an_empty_queue_has_all_three_empty_groups():
+    assert roll_call(session(), []) == {"admitted": [], "waiting": [], "refused": []}

+"""Specification tests for setting and centring the theatre's playbill."""
+
+import unittest
+
+from playbill import centre, set_bill
+
+
+class ExplodesWhenSplit:
+    """Text stand-in used to prove validation happens before text is read."""
+
+    def split(self):
+        raise AssertionError("text was inspected before the measure was checked")
+
+
+class ExplodesWhenMeasured:
+    """Line stand-in used to prove validation happens before line width is read."""
+
+    def __len__(self):
+        raise AssertionError("line was inspected before the measure was checked")
+
+
+class SetBillTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_parts_words_on_all_whitespace_and_ignores_edges(self):
+        text = " \tHamlet   \n  is\t\ta  tragedy \n "
+
+        self.assertEqual(set_bill(text, 80), ["Hamlet is a tragedy"])
+
+    def test_wraps_words_at_the_measure_with_one_space_between_them(self):
+        text = "one two three four"
+
+        self.assertEqual(set_bill(text, 7), ["one two", "three", "four"])
+
+    def test_a_line_exactly_the_measure_fits_but_one_more_character_does_not(self):
+        text = "four five six"
+
+        self.assertEqual(set_bill(text, 9), ["four five", "six"])
+
+    def test_preserves_every_word_and_uses_no_edge_or_repeated_spaces(self):
+        text = "  now\t is\n the   winter  "
+        lines = set_bill(text, 6)
+
+        self.assertEqual(lines, ["now is", "the", "winter"])
+        self.assertEqual(" ".join(lines), "now is the winter")
+        self.assertTrue(all(line == line.strip() and "  " not in line for line in lines))
+
+    def test_a_word_wider_than_the_measure_is_unbroken_and_stands_alone(self):
+        text = "to extraordinarily be"
+
+        self.assertEqual(set_bill(text, 5), ["to", "extraordinarily", "be"])
+
+    def test_empty_or_whitespace_only_text_sets_no_lines(self):
+        for text in ("", " \t\n  "):
+            with self.subTest(text=repr(text)):
+                self.assertEqual(set_bill(text, 4), [])
+
+    def test_rejects_a_measure_less_than_one_before_reading_text(self):
+        for measure in (0, -3):
+            with self.subTest(measure=measure):
+                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+                    set_bill(ExplodesWhenSplit(), measure)
+
+
+class CentreTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_adds_floor_half_of_the_spare_space_before_the_line_only(self):
+        self.assertEqual(centre("Hamlet", 11), "  Hamlet")
+        self.assertFalse(centre("Hamlet", 11).endswith(" "))
+
+    def test_odd_spare_space_leans_the_line_to_the_left(self):
+        self.assertEqual(centre("word", 9), "  word")
+
+    def test_line_as_wide_as_or_wider_than_measure_is_unchanged(self):
+        self.assertEqual(centre("stage", 5), "stage")
+        self.assertEqual(centre("curtain", 5), "curtain")
+
+    def test_rejects_a_measure_less_than_one_before_measuring_line(self):
+        for measure in (0, -3):
+            with self.subTest(measure=measure):
+                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+                    centre(ExplodesWhenMeasured(), measure)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""Tests for the signal box train register.
+
+All example register lines and books used by this module live here so the
+file can be run independently.
+"""
+
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+# This module is deliberately self-contained rather than relying on pytest's
+# import-path configuration or a shared test helper.
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
+from register import read_entry, work_the_register
+
+
+def line(clock, headcode, movement, separator=" "):
+    """Make one written line of the register."""
+    return separator.join((clock, headcode, movement))
+
+
+def book(*entries):
+    """Make a complete register, in the order it was written."""
+    return list(entries)
+
+
+def test_read_entry_returns_minutes_headcode_and_movement():
+    assert read_entry(line("09:15", "1A24", "accepted")) == {
+        "minute": 9 * 60 + 15,
+        "headcode": "1A24",
+        "movement": "accepted",
+    }
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("clock", "minute"),
+    [
+        ("00:00", 0),
+        ("00:59", 59),
+        ("01:00", 60),
+        ("23:59", 1439),
+    ],
+)
+def test_read_entry_converts_clock_boundaries_to_minutes(clock, minute):
+    entry = read_entry(line(clock, "1A24", "entered"))
+
+    assert entry["minute"] == minute
+
+
+def test_read_entry_ignores_whitespace_at_ends_and_between_fields():
+    entry = read_entry(" \t09:15\t\t1A24   cleared \n")
+
+    assert entry == {"minute": 555, "headcode": "1A24", "movement": "cleared"}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "bad_line",
+    [
+        "",
+        "09:15",
+        "09:15 1A24",
+        "09:15 1A24 accepted extra",
+    ],
+)
+def test_read_entry_rejects_anything_other_than_three_fields(bad_line):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        read_entry(bad_line)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "clock",
+    [
+        "9:15",
+        "09:5",
+        "0915",
+        "09-15",
+        "aa:15",
+        "09:aa",
+        "24:00",
+        "23:60",
+    ],
+)
+def test_read_entry_rejects_malformed_or_out_of_range_clock(clock):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        read_entry(line(clock, "1A24", "accepted"))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "headcode",
+    [
+        "A124",
+        "1a24",
+        "1AA4",
+        "1A2A",
+        "1A2",
+        "1A245",
+    ],
+)
+def test_read_entry_rejects_headcodes_outside_the_required_shape(headcode):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        read_entry(line("09:15", headcode, "accepted"))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("movement", ["Accepted", "ENTERED", "clear", "clearer"])
+def test_read_entry_rejects_any_movement_other_than_the_three_words(movement):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        read_entry(line("09:15", "1A24", movement))
+
+
+def test_empty_register_has_no_train_no_clearances_and_no_movements():
+    assert work_the_register(book()) == {
+        "in_section": None,
+        "cleared": [],
+        "movements": 0,
+    }
+
+
+def test_blank_register_lines_are_ignored():
+    assert work_the_register(book("", "   ", "\t\n")) == {
+        "in_section": None,
+        "cleared": [],
+        "movements": 0,
+    }
+
+
+def test_register_tracks_a_train_in_the_section_and_counts_entries():
+    result = work_the_register(
+        book(
+            line("09:00", "1A24", "accepted"),
+            "   ",
+            line("09:02", "1A24", "entered"),
+        )
+    )
+
+    assert result == {"in_section": "1A24", "cleared": [], "movements": 2}
+
+
+def test_register_records_clearances_in_the_order_they_happen():
+    result = work_the_register(
+        book(
+            line("09:00", "1A24", "accepted"),
+            line("09:01", "1A24", "entered"),
+            line("09:10", "1A24", "cleared"),
+            line("09:11", "2B25", "accepted"),
+            line("09:12", "2B25", "entered"),
+            line("09:20", "2B25", "cleared"),
+        )
+    )
+
+    assert result == {"in_section": None, "cleared": ["1A24", "2B25"], "movements": 6}
+
+
+def test_a_headcode_can_be_offered_again_after_it_has_cleared():
+    result = work_the_register(
+        book(
+            line("09:00", "1A24", "accepted"),
+            line("09:01", "1A24", "entered"),
+            line("09:02", "1A24", "cleared"),
+            line("10:00", "1A24", "accepted"),
+        )
+    )
+
+    assert result == {"in_section": None, "cleared": ["1A24"], "movements": 4}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "entries",
+    [
+        book(line("09:00", "1A24", "accepted"), line("09:01", "1A24", "accepted")),
+        book(
+            line("09:00", "1A24", "accepted"),
+            line("09:01", "1A24", "entered"),
+            line("09:02", "1A24", "accepted"),
+        ),
+    ],
+)
+def test_register_rejects_offering_a_headcode_already_on_it(entries):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        work_the_register(entries)
+
+
+def test_register_rejects_entering_without_a_prior_acceptance():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        work_the_register(book(line("09:00", "1A24", "entered")))
+
+
+def test_register_rejects_a_second_train_entering_an_occupied_section():
+    entries = book(
+        line("09:00", "1A24", "accepted"),
+        line("09:01", "2B25", "accepted"),
+        line("09:02", "1A24", "entered"),
+        line("09:03", "2B25", "entered"),
+    )
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        work_the_register(entries)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "entries",
+    [
+        book(line("09:00", "1A24", "cleared")),
+        book(
+            line("09:00", "1A24", "accepted"),
+            line("09:01", "1A24", "entered"),
+            line("09:02", "2B25", "cleared"),
+        ),
+    ],
+)
+def test_register_rejects_a_clearance_by_any_train_other_than_the_one_inside(entries):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        work_the_register(entries)
+
+
+def test_register_rejects_an_entry_earlier_than_the_one_above_it():
+    entries = book(
+        line("09:01", "1A24", "accepted"),
+        line("09:00", "1A24", "entered"),
+    )
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        work_the_register(entries)
+
+
+def test_register_keeps_same_minute_entries_in_the_written_order():
+    result = work_the_register(
+        book(
+            line("09:00", "1A24", "accepted"),
+            line("09:00", "1A24", "entered"),
+            line("09:00", "1A24", "cleared"),
+        )
+    )
+
+    assert result == {"in_section": None, "cleared": ["1A24"], "movements": 3}
+
+
+def test_register_propagates_an_invalid_nonblank_line_as_value_error():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        work_the_register(book(line("09:00", "1A24", "accepted"), "not a register line"))
